findings.evidence: In descriptor.json, metadata.constants.vaultTicker is "CSUSDC" and the 'Share ticker' field uses "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker". findings.fix: Set metadata.constants.vaultTicker to "COUSDC". Better: show the shares as a tokenAmount with tokenPath "@.to" and drop the raw ticker constant.

findings.format: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
findings.title: redeem shows the burned shares as CSUSDC, but the signer's shares are COUSDC.
findings.reason: The descriptor binds the shares amount to the vault token itself (tokenPath "@.to" = 0x1d3b…4657), which is the token whose shares are burned. The amount is also correct: 9251795000000000000 at 18 decimals is 9.251795. The CSUSDC symbol comes from the wallet's token lookup, not from a wrong token in the descriptor. The asset, amount and owner shown all match the mined burn, so at most this is a ticker/metadata warning.
